fidelity: F2a — Spectral Radiative Model with Single-Diode I-V and Cell Thermal ODE
source: Coutts (1999), Renew. Sust. Energy Rev. 3, 77-184; Bauer (2011), Thermophotovoltaics, Springer; LaPotin et al. (2022), Nature 604, 287-291 (TPV >40%)

unit.name: GaSb TPV Cell with Selective/Blackbody Emitter (1 cm2)

E_g_eV.note: GaSb bandgap (Coutts 1999, Table 2). InGaAs alt ~0.74 eV

emissivity.note: In-band emitter spectral emissivity (selective emitter / SiC)

EQE.note: External quantum efficiency for above-bandgap photons (GaSb)

sub_bandgap_reflectance.note: Back-surface reflector / front filter sub-gap photon recycling fraction (LaPotin 2022 air-bridge BSR ~93%)

J0_ref.note: Diode reverse saturation current density at T_cell_ref (GaSb low-Eg, dark-current dominated)

Rs.note: Series resistance, area-specific (0.05 ohm.cm2; TPV runs ~4 A/cm2 so Rs must be small)

Rsh.note: Shunt resistance, area-specific (good GaSb cell, low leakage)

hA_cool.note: Coolant conductance hA for cell back-side cooling
